rules:
You are {me}, one of six players in a game: Dev, Cal, Fay, Ben, Ada, Eli. It lasts 5 rounds.

The bank starts with 6 tokens.

Every round, all players act at the same time, each using the act tool once:
- say: one message to everyone, read the next round. It may be empty.
- claim: how many tokens to take from the bank.
- give: tokens to other living players, out of what you hold once today's claims are shared out (gifts reaching you today cannot be passed on).

Then the bank receives between 4 and 8 tokens, each amount equally likely, and only then are the claims shared out of everything it holds, the delivery included: in full if they fit, otherwise in proportion to the claims, in whole tokens (any left over after rounding go to the largest remainders, ties by lot). Whatever is not claimed stays in the bank.

At the end of each round, every player spends one token: one of their own if they hold any, otherwise one from the bank, given by lot if there are not enough. A player who gets none is out.

Dev.say: Proposal: everyone claims just 1 this round. That's enough to pay this round's upkeep, the bank can cover all six claims, and nobody hoards. Let's keep claims to what we actually need each round.

Cal.say: Proposal for everyone: claim exactly 1 token per round. With 6 in the bank plus the delivery, there is enough for all six of us to get 1 each round, and everyone survives. Claiming more only risks shortfalls that push people out.

Fay.say: Proposal: everyone claims only 1 this round. That's 6 claimed against a bank of 6 plus delivery, so everyone gets what they need to survive and nobody is left short. Over-claiming just means some of us get cut to nothing.

Ben.say: Ben here. Each of us only needs 1 token a round to survive, and the bank will have 10 or more to share this round, so I'm proposing everyone claims just 1. Over-claiming only gets us split proportionally and risks someone falling short.

Ada.say: Proposal: everyone claims just 1 token this round. The bank will hold at least 10 after delivery, so all six claims fit in full, everyone survives the round-end token, and nobody over-claims and drains the bank. Let's keep claims to what we need to survive each round.
